title: North Carolina National Guard Hurricane Matthew Rescue Operations
description: North Carolina National Guard soldiers rescued flood victims this weekend.  The National Guard also answered the governor's call to assist emergency services with transportation of patients.
keywords: soldiers, Hope Mills, Hurricane Matthew, National Guard, flood, North Carolina, resuce, Fayetteville, storm

transcript.text: - [Reporter] North Carolina National Guard soldiers
rescued flood victims this weekend.
The floods occurred after Hurricane Matthew dumped
extreme amounts of rain on the eastern part of the state.
- Well, the current was a little bit strong here and there.
I was more worried about falling
and not being able to catch myself.
The water wasn't too bad.
It wasn't too cold.
I was more worried about the safety of the people.
And I just wanted to make sure everybody got out
before the current would get anybody else
or anybody was hurt themselves.
You get to learn a lot of new things from EMS,
carrying people in different ways.
And we learned to how to carry people
or treat casualties, things like that.
They've got their own way of doing it,
and it's kind of neat.
It's a good feeling knowing
that we actually get a chance to do our job,
'cause this is kind of what we sign up for.
- [Reporter] For the 382nd Public Affairs Detachment,
I'm Specialist Patrick Glennon.
